Summary: Seacliff builds perception+decisioning pipelines for Level 3/4 vehicles. Heavy mix of short-chat-like requests (operator queries) + high-rate reranking for sensor fusion.
- Wants hard throughput guarantees for peak driving windows (rush/edge cases).
- "preferred outcome": deterministic p95 latency and reserved GPU pools per region.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to 12mo reserved if SLAs and failover plan in contract.
- Quoted: "can't have backoffs when vehicles are in active drive windows".
- Typical request shapes: 50-400 tokens per request (rerank + context), some long post-ops summarization up to 2k tokens.
- Current stack: on-prem inference for safety-critical loops, cloud for ops telemetry and human-in-the-loop.
- Wants Redwood to recommend GPU counts and fallback bands (H100 primary, A10G for spill).
- Legal asks for data residency in NA and audit log retention 7 years.
baseline_qps_target: steady-state 180 qps across control-plane APIs (embedding + rerank mix)
peak_qps_target: burst peaks up to 1,200 qps for 3-5 minute windows (event-driven maneuvers)

latency_slos: p50 < 60ms for control queries; p95 < 200ms for combined rerank+response during steady; p95 < 350ms tolerated for peaks with documented fallback policy
sla_items: availability 99.9% for dedicated pool; model-swap MTTR < 30m; guaranteed throughput tiers (steady + burst); regional failover plan; monthly performance reporting; on-call escalation path
